churches.assessment: Apostles Anglican Church in west Knoxville is an ACNA parish in the Anglican Diocese of the South, led by Rector Rev. Jack King — who also serves as Dean of the Tennessee Convocation (ADOTS). He has been rector for over 13 years, providing mature pastoral leadership. The church is known for its 'scruffy hospitality' ethos and has been profiled in ACNA communications. The parish maintains one of the richest liturgical rhythms profiled here: Sunday services at 8:45 AM (with choral music), 11:15 AM (with acoustic music), plus 10:10 Formation Hour; Monday-Thursday daily Morning Prayer (8:30 AM), Midday Prayer (noon), and Evening Prayer (4:00 PM); and a Wednesday Noon Eucharist with Healing Service. Three strategic priorities include becoming a mother church, deepening spiritual formation across all ages, and serving the local neighborhood. ACNA 39 Articles framework with male-only ordination. Strong green-rated Anglican option for the Knoxville metro.

churches.assessment: Greater Tabernacle Missionary Baptist (Lawrenceburg TN) called Rev. Shonda Reynolds Christian as senior pastor in June 2015 and was disfellowshipped by the Lawrence County Association of Baptists by a 73-4 vote on October 12, 2015 — the association explicitly citing the Baptist Faith and Message 2000 Article VI ('the office of pastor is limited to men as qualified by Scripture'). Pastor Christian, who continues to lead the church a decade later, publicly characterized the disfellowship as 'unchristian' and challenged the binding force of the 2000 BF&M revision. This case set the early modern precedent for SBC state-association action against churches with female senior pastors and remains the longest-running Mid-South case.
churches.gender_detail: Senior Pastor: Rev. Shonda Reynolds Christian (called June 2015, still serving). Lawrence County Association cited BF&M 2000 Article VI as the explicit reason for the 73-4 disfellowship vote.
churches.denomination_detail: Lawrence County Association of Baptists disfellowshipped Oct 12, 2015. Tennessee Baptist Mission Board (TBMB) and SBC affiliation status downstream of the local-association action — the congregation no longer participates in SBC cooperative structures.
churches.enrichment_notes: Earliest modern Mid-South precedent for state-association disfellowship of an SBC-cooperating church over a female senior pastor. Pastor Christian's tenure has now exceeded a decade, making this an enduring drift case rather than a transient one.

churches.assessment: Zion Presbyterian Church is an Orthodox Presbyterian Church congregation in Athens, Tennessee, in the Presbytery of the Southeast. The OPC was founded in 1936 by J. Gresham Machen in defense of Reformed orthodoxy against theological liberalism — strict subscription to the Westminster Standards, male-only ordination, confessional accountability via presbytery, and Reformed expository preaching are denominational hallmarks. Rev. A. J. Millsaps serves as Pastor. For a man wanting confessional Reformed theology with the strictest US Presbyterian accountability, Zion OPC is a top-tier choice in east Tennessee.
